channel.title: shaunalynn — Notebook
channel.description: Notes, questions, fragments, poems, and essays.

item.title: Making a place for things
item.description: What would it mean for a personal site to feel more like a celebration than a résumé—and more like a lab notebook than a publication?

item.title: The world as a text
item.description: A future home for small observations, quotations, arguments, and correspondences: rough enough to remain alive.

item.title: Longer pieces will live here too
item.description: Essays, poems, and polemics do not need a separate building. They can sit beside notes, questions, and fragments without becoming the measure of them.
